title: sunset-vs-fold-decision template variables
description: Values for templates/sunset-vs-fold-decision.md.j2 and templates/sunset-vs-fold-decision.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from sunset-vs-fold-decision.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: What was decided - retire the product, fold it into another, or defer the decision? Defer is a real answer, but only with a date and a trigger written under it.

document_version.description: Which revision of this decision record is this? These records get revisited when the numbers move, and the version is how a reader knows which one the board saw.

product_name.description: Which product is this decision about - the name a customer would recognise? One product per record; a bundle decided together is a bundle nobody can revisit separately.
